status: round1 research completed before round2 assignment

decisions.issue: Does append-only persistence choose the world?
decisions.revision: No; it is common infrastructure. Record-only is expression baseline, mechanical resistance and separately authored encounters remain alternatives.
Native turns/prefill/raw streams all require host choices. Do not erase emittedEOS, infer rest fromEOS or assume a STOP protocol is understood.
TextWorld/LIGHT and human interaction findings motivate architecture/observer controls, not135M efficacy or developmental equivalence.

round2_questions: Specify a minimal continuing candidate with visible host intervention and exact context budget, alongside single-reply/manual baseline. Avoid forcing STOP syntax.
Separate a free expression baseline from an optional independently consequential contact; preserve all prose regardless syntax.
Make independent prediction/participation/observer influence operational without model-facing schema or continuous scoring.

side_expansion.basis: root read Lazaridou§§2-5 and critical reviewer methods/scope; mechanism supports information-access design question, not frozen-model learning
side_expansion.target: human collaborative reference/grounding; optional clarification/repair affordances
side_expansion.critical_addition: Check identifiability: symmetric or independently relabeled views may make intended target impossible to distinguish. A meaningful message must be able to help without leaking target via order/IDs.
